lines.text: There's a jellyfish that refuses to die of old age. Ever.

parts.tts: There's a jellyfish that refuses to die of old age. Ever.
parts.heard: There's a jellyfish that refuses to die of old age. Ever.

lines.text: When the immortal jellyfish gets injured, or starts starving, it doesn't die. It hits the reset button.

parts.tts: When the immortal jellyfish gets injured, or starts starving, it doesn't die. It hits the reset button.
parts.heard: When the immortal jellyfish gets injured, or starts starving, it doesn't die. It hits the reset button.

lines.text: It melts into a blob, sinks to the seafloor, and transforms back into a baby.

parts.tts: It melts into a blob, sinks to the seafloor, and transforms back into a baby.
parts.heard: It melts into a blob, sinks to the seafloor, and transforms back into a baby.

lines.text: Then it grows up again. And again. And again. It's called transdifferentiation.

parts.tts: Then it grows up again. And again. And again. It's called transdifferentiation.
parts.heard: then it grows up again, and again, and again, it's called transdifferentiation.

lines.text: Imagine a butterfly turning back into a caterpillar every time life got hard.

parts.tts: Imagine a butterfly turning back into a caterpillar every time life got hard.
parts.heard: Imagine a butterfly turning back into a caterpillar every time life got hard.

lines.text: It's smaller than your pinky nail, and in theory, it can do this forever.

parts.tts: It's smaller than your pinky nail, and in theory, it can do this forever.
parts.heard: It's smaller than your pinky nail, and in theory, it can do this forever.

lines.text: The catch? Fish and turtles eat it. Immortal, but also... lunch.

parts.tts: The catch? Fish and turtles eat it. Immortal, but also...
parts.heard: The catch? Fish and turtles eat it. Immortal, but also...

lines.text: It cheats old age... and it doesn't even have a brain.

parts.tts: and it doesn't even have a brain.
parts.heard: And it doesn't even have a brain.
